channel.title: Animal Equality – Bias and Credibility - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Animal Equality – Bias and Credibility (animalequality.org)

item.title: Newborn calves pinned, smacked, cursed at on dairy farm
item.description: Animal Equality uncovered abuse at an organic, RSPCA-assured U.K. dairy farm, where calves were pinned, smacked in the face, cursed at, and force-fed.

item.title: What supermarkets don’t show you about U.S. pig farms | Animal Equality
item.description: Animal Equality filmed pigs dying on a U.S. farm linked to major grocers. Pregnant pigs were confined in crates, unable to turn around or escape.

item.title: No way out: The pregnant cow who was slaughtered anyway | Animal Equality
item.description: A pregnant cow is slaughtered, her live calf pulled from her womb. Here’s what Animal Equality captured during an investigation into the meat industry.

item.title: Meet The Team: Evan Lesmez
item.description: Evan is a software engineer with a deep passion for technology and its potential to drive change.

item.title: Meet the team: Male Flores | Animal Equality
item.description: Meet Male Flores, an animal advocate whose journey began with a simple question. Try her favorite plant-based recipe: stuffed gorditas from Love Veg Latino.

item.title: Ag-gag laws: Silencing the truth about animal cruelty
item.description: Ag-gag laws make exposing animal abuse a crime. See what investigators have uncovered and what factory farms don’t want you to know.

item.title: Argentina’s kill floors: What animals see before they die | Animal Equality
item.description: An Investigations team member describes scenes from the kill floor, where animals are bludgeoned with sledgehammers in full view of each other.

item.title: They tried to silence me at the world’s largest animal sacrifice | Animal Equality
item.description: At Nepal’s Gadhimai Festival, I saw tens of thousands of animals slaughtered. Here’s what officials tried to keep hidden at the world’s largest sacrifice.

item.title: Dragged through mud and manure: How cows suffer for dairy
item.description: A cow unable to stand was dragged by tractors–her face scraping along the floor–during a dairy farm investigation aired by the BBC.

item.title: Federal lawsuit challenges Michigan cage-free egg law
item.description: A new federal lawsuit seeks to strike down Michigan’s cage-free egg law. Experts warn the outcome could affect similar laws across the country.
